steps.name: Martelli's Letter
steps.objective: Go to the "Free Trade City of Riveria" and find [Martelli].

steps.name: Kingdom of the Dwarves
steps.objective: Talk to [Martelli], then find [Alvis] on "Marin Island".

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: You're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it this time?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Nothing serious has happened yet... but there's something I'd like to ask of you.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Have you heard of a country called Archi City?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know much about it.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: It's a dwarven kingdom on Merin Island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, a dwarven kingdom...

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Its second prince, Juan, is a close friend of mine.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: We've known each other for quite a long time.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: We correspond regularly, but this time I haven't heard a thing.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: I heard that the recent incident at the Magic Stone Laboratory caused trouble in Archi City...

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: But with no word from Prince Juan, I'm terribly worried.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you like me to go to Archi City and see what's happening?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: A spirited young dwarven woman named Dorun usually delivered our letters.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: I wonder if something really has happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That shouldn't be difficult.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back soon.

steps.name: The Road to Archi City
steps.objective: Talk to [Alvis], then go to "Archi City" and defeat [Acid Lava Bubbles] and [Killing Machine Boxers]. Afterward, find [Dorun].

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Well, it's been a long time.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: What brings you here again? Come to do some hunting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm trying to get to Archi City, but I don't know the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Martelli asked me to go there on an errand.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Hmm. That could be dangerous. I hear things have been rather turbulent there lately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Turbulent?

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: They fought several battles against the artificial life-forms that escaped from the Magic Stone Laboratory...

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: And something seems to have gone wrong along the way.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Archi City's troops have been showing up here from time to time as well.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: They've been searching the Magic Stone Laboratory like their lives depend on it...

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: You'd be better off staying away. Things are so tense that even I avoid the area.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Even so, I think I should take a look for myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's what Martelli asked me to do.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 알비스
lines.text: Archi City is on the edge of Merin Island. Go straight across the island and you'll see it.

steps.name: Brave Dorun
steps.objective: Talk to [Dorun], then defeat [Yellow Archi Golems] and [Blaster Kabots] in "Archi City". Report to [Dorun] afterward.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Huh? A human, here...?!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: W-who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Martelli sent me to see Prince Juan, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...They said it was dangerous. Perhaps I shouldn't have come.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Martelli... He's the one I was planning to visit.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Prince Hurin's faction despises humans, so you can't be one of their people...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, may I ask your name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Martelli said that a dwarven woman named Dorun delivered Prince Juan's letters...

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: I'm Dorun.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: If you know that much, you must be...

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Hmm. Still, I need to verify your identity properly...

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Please prove that you really were sent by Martelli, Prince Juan's close friend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

steps.name: King of the Dwarves
steps.objective: Talk to [Dorun], then defeat [Hurin] aboard the "Dwarf Airship" and obtain the [Prison Key]. Return and report to [Dorun].

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: You're back! I saw your exploits clearly with my own eyes.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: That was truly remarkable!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Now I can trust that you aren't one of King Hurin's spies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what's going on in Archi City?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are other dwarves attacking you?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: The truth is... His Majesty passed away recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did it happen?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Have you heard of the Magic Stone Laboratory?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: It's a laboratory built by the humans of Riveria to create artificial life-forms...

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Monsters that escaped from it attacked Archi City.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: His Majesty led the army to defend the kingdom, and in the battle...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: The eldest prince, Hurin, ascended the throne, vowing revenge.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: In the process, he imprisoned Prince Juan for opposing an attack on Riveria.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Hurin has far too much confidence in Archi City's strength.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: He's using revenge as a pretext for what is really a war of conquest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then should I rescue Prince Juan?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Hurin has the key to his cell.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: That means breaking through his heavily guarded army and defeating him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds a little difficult, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll find a way.

steps.name: A Prince Behind Bars
steps.objective: Talk to [Dorun], then find [Juan] inside the "Dwarf Airship".

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: You're truly incredible!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: I heard Hurin's personal machine boasted the very best performance...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, the armor was certainly tough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It had quite a few interesting features too...

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: After defeating that incredible war machine, that's all you have to say...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Compared to the enemies I'll be facing, that was nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, now that I have the key, I'd better rescue Prince Juan.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Please see this through to the end!

steps.name: Securing an Escape Route
steps.objective: Talk to [Juan], then report to [Dorun] in "Archi City".

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: If you obtained the key... may I assume you defeated my brother?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You could put it that way.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: You're truly remarkable.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: I owe both you and Martelli an enormous debt.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: I, Juan, will remember it and repay you for the rest of my life!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What will you do now?

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: Thanks to you, I think convincing them will be easier.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: I intend to persuade my brother's followers to change course.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: Look at the adventurer who defeated you!

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: That is the potential of the humans you looked down on!

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: You couldn't even handle one of them and suffered such humiliation...

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: What disaster are you trying to bring upon us by talking of war?

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: We must be on friendly terms with them.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: It's good to take pride in being dwarves, but we must abandon our stubborn arrogance.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: We have much to learn from humans.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: I will serve as a bridge between us.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: We must seek progress through diplomacy, not war.

lines.speaker: 후안
lines.text: ...That's what I'll tell them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's admirable.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help you see it through.

steps.name: Back to Riveria
steps.objective: Talk to [Dorun], then go to the "Free Trade City of Riveria" and find [Martelli].

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Thank you for rescuing the prince!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: I must return to his side now!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are still plenty of enemies who are hostile to us, so be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And let me know if anything happens.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that we've met, I'll help however I can.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Uuuugh...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: A-a storm has begun to rage!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Where? Where's the storm...?!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Inside my heart...

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: A storm of emotion... Forgive me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I'll make sure to provide proper service right through to the end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll secure an escape route. Head to Prince Juan when you see an opening.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Understood!

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: ...So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: What I thought was a simple favor turned into something far bigger.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: I'm sorry. Please accept my apology.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It wasn't all that difficult.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: We came dangerously close to a major war.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: But Prince Juan made the right decision.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: No matter how impressive their technology might be...

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Going to war with Riveria would have been truly reckless.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: This city doesn't stand alone.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: I don't think we'd have lost even if we'd fought on our own, but...

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: The new mayor and the rest of the leadership are all clever people.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: They would have asked our allies for help.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Prince Juan's judgment saved Archi City from disaster.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I see.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: There should be an interesting round of diplomacy soon.

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: I have much to prepare, so please report to the mayor for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come to think of it, who is Riveria's new mayor?

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Don't you remember who led us?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it was...

lines.speaker: 마르텔리
lines.text: Go and see. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: You're here, adventurer!

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: I was planning to contact you soon... You've come at a good time!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So you're the mayor now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Congratulations.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: It's not all good news.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: There's so much work... I spend all my time signing paperwork.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: But what brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Eva what happened in Archi City.)

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: You've accomplished something truly important.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Please leave the aftermath to me.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you for saving Riveria from disaster once again.

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: How can we ever repay you...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take your time. You can repay me when things settle down.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You must be busy, so I'll be going...

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Have a safe journey!

lines.speaker: 에바
lines.text: Thank you so much!
